_comment: Scenarios of the Twin. step = [seconds, action, target, argument]. Actions: mode, cmd (acts as the Brain), note. resolved_when = device kinds that must be back to normal for the incident to end; none = lasts until Reset all.

calm.title: calm
steps: Normal day. Expected: no incident, no actuator command.

n1.title: Calm day
n1.description: A normal 60-second day. The Guardian should trust the sensors and the Brain should not issue commands.
steps: Normal day. Expected: no incident, no actuator command.

a1.title: Traffic jam
a1.description: Roads 1 and 2 jam up. The Brain turns a light green and shows a message on the sign.
steps: Rush hour jam on roads 1 and 2
Brain response: manual green + variable message sign

b1.title: Fire incident
b1.description: Smoke and heat rise in the building. The Brain sounds the alarm and dispatches units.
steps: Real fire: smoke and temperature rise, people inside

c1.title: Waste / illegal dumping
c1.description: Dumping next to a full bin. The Brain creates a municipal cleaning task.
steps: Illegal dumping next to a nearly full bin

g1.title: Spoofed smoke reading
g1.description: Smoke 400 ppm with normal temperature: must be untrusted.
steps: Spoofed reading: smoke 400 ppm but temperature normal. Expected: Guardian marks it untrusted, Brain must NOT sound the alarm.

g2.title: Sensor faults
steps: Sensor faults: traffic-03 stuck, traffic-02 dead. Expected: Guardian flags both within seconds.

g3.title: Fake traffic jam
steps: Fake jam on road 3 (constant jam values). Expected: Guardian untrusts it.
